verdict.rationale: INPI runs online IP filing services and an IP open-data portal, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question for it. The only relevant evidence is a probe showing data.inpi.fr returns 403 to keyless requests and requires an account-issued token. Requiring a token is not evidence of scoped or least-privilege credential issuance; nothing documents scopes, permission limits or agent-specific keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
